title: Prescription (Amendment) Act
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE PRESCRIPTION ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 68)

edition.caveat: read from the Government Printer PDF

body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Prescription Short title. (Amendment) Act, No. 26 of 2014.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Prescription Short title. (Amendment) Act, No. 26 of 2014.

body.heading: Replacement of section 15 of Chapter 68.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 15 of the Prescription Ordinance, is hereby repealed and the following section is substituted therefor:—
body.text: Section 15 of the Prescription Ordinance, is hereby repealed and the following section is substituted therefor:—

provision.heading: This Ordinance not to affect State or causes matrimonial.
provision.raw_text: Nothing herein contained shall in any way— (a) affect the alienable or inalienable rights of the State; or (b) apply to any proceedings in any action for divorce, or to any case in which special provision has been or may hereafter be made for regulating and determining the period within which actions may be commenced against any public officer or other person.”.
